title: Crying Gift Doll Christmas
description: A sad, stitched doll with large teary eyes and a bandaged body sits on golden fabric in front of a glowing Christmas tree. The red and green doll is wrapped in paper strips reading 'To Friend' and 'From Friend', surrounded by colorful gift boxes, an open red box labeled 'To ANNIE', and scattered ribbons.
